items.source: SemiAnalysis, ClusterMAX 1.0 / How to Rent GPUs
items.text: SemiAnalysis documented the 2024 decline in H100 rental prices as a wave of capacity ordered during the 2023 shortage came online at once. The report introduced the ClusterMAX rating system for GPU cloud providers.
Apollo Academy estimates combined hyperscaler capital expenditure of about $646 billion in 2026, up sharply from 2025, with most of the increase directed at AI data centres and accelerators.

items.source: SemiAnalysis, The Great GPU Shortage: Rental Capacity (H100 one-year rental price index)
items.text: SemiAnalysis launched an H100 one-year rental price index built from monthly surveys of more than 100 market participants. The one-year contract price rose from $1.70 per GPU-hour in October 2025 to $2.35 in March 2026, a rise of almost 40%. The firm reported on-demand capacity sold out across all GPU types and said all capacity coming online until August to September 2026 had already been booked.

In its third-quarter fiscal 2026 release IREN cautioned that its stated contracted annualised revenue is not fully contracted and that actual revenue may differ materially from the run-rate figures it reports.

TSMC's advanced-packaging (CoWoS) supply-demand gap is reportedly about 20% and is expected to narrow to about 10% by the end of 2026. TSMC capacity could reach 120,000 to 140,000 wafers a month by then, and close to 200,000 including outsourced partners.

IREN reported about $4 billion of contracted annualised revenue for 2026 capacity, of which about $1 billion is operating today. AI Cloud revenue for fiscal 2026 (year ended June 30, 2026) was $128.8 million.

The 10-K describes a contract with Microsoft worth about $9.7 billion running through 2031 and a contract with NVIDIA worth about $3.4 billion, the two anchor agreements behind the contracted revenue figure.
Closing share price on September 30, 2026: $40.88. Shares outstanding about 394 million, implying an approximate market capitalisation of about $16 billion.

TrendForce projects the average selling price of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) will rise 121% in 2027 as shortages persist. Micron has contracted the bulk of its 2027 HBM supply. Second-quarter 2026 HBM revenue share was SK Hynix 50%, Samsung 33% and Micron 18% (Counterpoint).

items.source: SemiAnalysis ClusterMAX 3.0, IREN rating (via secondary coverage)
items.text: In ClusterMAX 3.0, SemiAnalysis's rating of 77 GPU cloud providers, IREN was rated Underperforming, the lowest tier, according to secondary coverage of the report. Platinum-tier providers command a pricing premium; lower tiers compete mainly on price.

items.source: IREN statement reported by a news wire (SYNTHETIC)
items.text: IREN disclosed that first-phase deliveries under its anchor AI cloud contract have been deferred by about nine months at the customer's request, moving about $600 million of expected fiscal 2027 revenue into fiscal 2028. The company said its 2026 operating-capacity target is unchanged.

items.source: Company press release via news wire (SYNTHETIC)
items.text: IREN published its annual sustainability report, updating its renewable-energy sourcing disclosures and site-level water-use figures for its data centres.
